title: Taste whisky like a pro

cards.head: Swirl.
cards.sub: Gently. Watch the drops run down.
cards.body: Those slow streaks on the glass are called ‘legs’ or ‘tears’.

cards.head: Nose.
cards.body: Don’t dive in. Hold the glass just below your nose; the alcohol hits first.

cards.head: Sip.
cards.sub: Hold it on your tongue for a few seconds.
cards.body: Let it coat your mouth, swallow, then notice the ‘finish’.

cards.head: Add water.
cards.sub: A few drops. Then taste again.
cards.body: A 2017 study found a little water can bring the flavour forward.

outro.cta: Save this for your next tasting. Send it to the friend who gulps.
outro.pill: SIP SLOW · NEVER DRINK AND DRIVE

caption:
Are you drinking whisky wrong? 🥃 4 simple steps to taste it like a pro: swirl, nose, sip, add water.

Swirl: gently, and watch the legs run down the glass.
Nose: small sniffs, lips slightly open.
Sip: hold it on your tongue for a few seconds.
Water: add a few drops and taste again. Science says it can bring the flavour forward.

Save this for your next whisky tasting 🔖 and send it to the friend who gulps.

Sip slow. Never drink and drive. 18+
